sights.n: Pokémon Center Sapporo (ポケモンセンターサッポロ)
sights.address: Daimaru Sapporo 8F, Kita 5-jō Nishi 4-7, Chuo-ku, Sapporo 060-0005, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Hokkaido's only official Pokémon Center, on the 8th floor of Daimaru by Sapporo Station — ~2,500 items incl. Sapporo-only Pikachu goods and pins.
sights.anime: Pokémon — the franchise's official flagship store for Hokkaido, with Sapporo-exclusive merchandise

sights.n: Hokuchin Memorial Museum, Asahikawa (北鎮記念館)
sights.w: Free JGSDF museum at Camp Asahikawa on the Imperial Army's 7th Division and Meiji-era Asahikawa — uniforms and bayonets that Golden Kamuy fans come to see.
sights.anime: Golden Kamuy — the real 7th Division's museum; Noda Satoru's uniform references, a core fan pilgrimage

sights.w: Hakodate's arena by Yunokawa Onsen — the Love Live! regional-preliminary venue in Sunshine!! S2 and the real home of the 2018 Saint Snow-hosted Hakodate Unit Carnival.
sights.anime: Love Live! Sunshine!! — the Hakodate venue of the S2 regional preliminaries (Saint Snow's home city)

sights.n: Snow Miku Sky Town, New Chitose Airport (雪ミク スカイタウン)
sights.address: Domestic Terminal 4F, New Chitose Airport, Chitose, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Shop-and-museum for Snow Miku, the white Hatsune Miku born from a 2010 Sapporo Snow Festival sculpture — life-size figure, illustrations, airport-only goods.
sights.anime: Hatsune Miku / Snow Miku — Sapporo-based Crypton's Hokkaido mascot Miku, with her permanent airport museum
